status_legend.INHERITED_POLICY: Existing Trade AI policy that the Temporal design must preserve; not proof of a Temporal implementation.
status_legend.REQUIRED_NOT_IMPLEMENTED: Mandatory before production adoption and not implemented by this due-diligence exercise.
status_legend.POC_REQUIRED: Must be proved in an isolated localhost POC or later controlled shadow test.
status_legend.NOT_APPLICABLE_TO_SELECTED_CLOUD_OPTION: A self-host-only control retained for comparison and possible future review.

protected_assets: source SHA and worker release integrity
principal_risks: a Temporal Worker importing or invoking broker, order, stop, risk, or 2FA capabilities
secrets or sensitive research entering persisted Workflow history, Memo, Search Attributes, logs, or failure messages
at-least-once Activity retry duplicating a paid provider call or domain write
unauthenticated access to a self-hosted Temporal Frontend or UI
Cloud metadata or plaintext payload exposure
Worker code/source drift across CURRENT, rebuild, or mutable worktrees
retry multiplication across Temporal, provider SDK, and existing queue layers
Temporal outage blocking financial protection, truth, or execution controls
over-broad namespace credentials or administration roles
trust_boundaries: Temporal Cloud Namespace or self-hosted Temporal Frontend

controls.control: Temporal is orchestration only and grants no financial authority.
controls.requirement: All Temporal workflows and task queues are stamped READ_ONLY_ADVISORY and MEMORY_BEHAVIOR_INFLUENCE=0.
controls.acceptance: Static configuration and runtime receipts show the authority fields on every start.

controls.control: Workers cannot access financial mutation code.
controls.requirement: Static import/call graph tests deny broker mutation, orders, stops, live risk-policy mutation, 2FA, paper trading, and execution routing modules.
controls.acceptance: CI guard passes on every Worker release; runtime financial writes remain zero.

controls.control: Financial controls are independent of Temporal availability.
controls.requirement: Stops, execution controls, broker reconciliation, price truth, position truth, risk enforcement, and 2FA remain outside Temporal and continue when Temporal is unavailable.
controls.acceptance: Dependency graph and outage test prove no financial-safety dependency on the Temporal endpoint.

controls.control: Temporal does not become the business database.
controls.requirement: Canonical portfolio, market, research, thesis, feedback, outcome, policy, and notification records remain in existing governed Trade AI stores; Workflow state carries stable IDs and versions.
controls.acceptance: Schema and code review find no canonical investment record stored only in Workflow history.

controls.control: Workflow payloads are bounded and reference-based.
controls.requirement: Do not place raw research responses, full RAG corpora, credentials, private keys, tokens, 2FA values, broker data dumps, or raw chain-of-thought in Workflow payloads or history.
controls.acceptance: Fixture scan and Event History export contain only approved identifiers, versions, hashes, bounded structured deltas, and non-secret diagnostics.

controls.control: Search Attributes contain non-sensitive bounded identifiers only.
controls.requirement: Allowlisted attributes may include symbol, situation_type, research_gap_id, thesis_id/version, decision_id, materiality, workflow_schema, source_sha, and authority; prohibit free text, theses, operator reasons, secrets, and provider prompts.
controls.acceptance: Search Attribute registry and sampled executions match the allowlist.

controls.control: Memo is omitted unless necessary and is encrypted when used.
controls.requirement: Memo must not duplicate domain records; any non-public Memo content uses the configured Payload Codec.
controls.acceptance: Execution samples show empty Memo or ciphertext only.

controls.control: Client-side payload encryption is mandatory for Cloud.
controls.requirement: Use a reviewed Python Data Converter/Payload Codec so Workflow, Activity, Child Workflow, Signal, Query, Memo, and configured failure payloads are encrypted before leaving Trade AI Clients or Workers.
controls.acceptance: Captured traffic and Cloud Event History show ciphertext; local Worker round trip and key rotation tests pass.

controls.control: Encryption keys stay outside Temporal.
controls.requirement: Codec keys are injected through existing secret management, never payloads or environment dumps, are least-privilege, versioned, rotatable, and recoverable under a documented escrow/backup policy.
controls.acceptance: Key inventory, access review, rotation rehearsal, and loss-recovery test pass.

controls.control: Failure messages and stack traces do not leak secrets.
controls.requirement: Sanitize ApplicationError messages and configure a Failure Converter if sensitive exception details could be persisted; structured error types carry no credentials or prompts.
controls.acceptance: Injected failures produce redacted history, logs, UI, and notifications.

controls.control: Codec Server is not an unauthenticated decryption oracle.
controls.requirement: If a Codec Server is deployed, keep it private/internal, require authentication and authorization, restrict CORS, log access without plaintext, rate limit, and never expose keys to Temporal Cloud.
controls.acceptance: Unauthorized decode requests fail; authorized UI/CLI decode works; endpoint is absent from public scans.

controls.control: Cloud Namespace authentication is least privilege.
controls.requirement: Use a dedicated Worker identity with Namespace-scoped API key or mTLS certificate; separate operator read/admin identities; no shared all-admin credential.
controls.acceptance: Role matrix, credential inventory, negative permission tests, and rotation test pass.

controls.control: Cloud credentials rotate and revoke cleanly.
controls.requirement: Document issuance, overlap rotation, expiration, emergency revocation, secret reload, and audit ownership for API keys or certificates.
controls.acceptance: A Worker reconnects under a rotated credential and the old credential is rejected.

controls.control: Cloud audit logs are exported and reviewed.
controls.requirement: Export Temporal Cloud API audit logs to existing security/operations monitoring with bounded retention and alert on admin, namespace, credential, and retention changes.
controls.acceptance: A controlled administrative change appears in the external audit sink and alert path.

controls.control: Cloud connection is outbound-only and allowlisted.
controls.requirement: Workers initiate TLS connections to the exact Namespace endpoint; deny unsolicited inbound access and arbitrary Temporal endpoints.
controls.acceptance: Firewall/egress policy and socket inventory show only approved endpoint access.

controls.control: Private Cloud connectivity is evaluated before production.
controls.requirement: Assess AWS PrivateLink or GCP Private Service Connect against host location, plan availability, cost, and one-user threat model; document an explicit accept/reject decision.
controls.acceptance: Architecture record states selected connectivity and residual risk.

controls.control: Every side-effecting Activity is idempotent.
controls.requirement: Use stable domain keys and database unique constraints for research, delta, thesis, decision, notification, feedback, and outcome writes; never rely only on Workflow Run ID for business dedupe across restarts or migration.
controls.acceptance: Forced Activity replay creates zero duplicate paid calls and zero duplicate canonical rows.

controls.control: Ambiguous provider calls use a pre-call reservation journal.
controls.requirement: Persist provider_call_id, request hash, producer/run, reservation status, provider request ID when available, terminal status, and cost before/after the network boundary; reconcile UNKNOWN outcomes rather than automatically issuing a second paid call.
controls.acceptance: Kill after provider success/before DB commit yields at most one provider charge and a reconcilable terminal record.

controls.control: Hard policy and budget failures never retry automatically.
controls.requirement: COST_CONFIGURATION_INVALID, COST_CAP_EXCEEDED, POLICY_NOT_ALLOWED, validation rejection, and authorization failure are non-retryable ApplicationError types unless an explicit operator/configuration signal changes the prerequisite.
controls.acceptance: Failure injection records one attempt and a deterministic terminal/wait state.

controls.control: There is one bounded retry layer.
controls.requirement: Inventory and disable multiplicative provider SDK, existing queue, shell, and Temporal retries; set per-Activity initial interval, coefficient, maximum interval, maximum attempts, timeout, and non-retryable types.
controls.acceptance: Retry matrix proves actual attempt counts under HTTP 500, timeout, circuit-open, cost-cap, and malformed-response cases.

controls.control: Long Activities heartbeat and cancel safely.
controls.requirement: External research and long RAG/index operations heartbeat bounded progress without embedding secrets or large content; cancellation stops future side effects and leaves a resumable journal state.
controls.acceptance: SIGKILL/cancel tests expose last heartbeat and resume or reconcile without duplication.

controls.control: Workflow code is deterministic.
controls.requirement: No direct HTTP, database, filesystem mutation, shell, LLM call, unseeded randomness, environment inspection, or non-Temporal wall-clock read occurs in Workflow code; side effects live in Activities.
controls.acceptance: Static review and replay tests pass under the Python Workflow sandbox.

controls.control: Workers run from immutable exact-main releases.
controls.requirement: Each Worker Deployment Version is stamped with source SHA, dependency lock hash, workflow/activity contract versions, build time, and authority; dirty rebuild and mutable CURRENT/worktree launches are denied.
controls.acceptance: Runtime health, Temporal metadata, and release manifest agree on exact SHA; pin_match is true.

controls.control: Worker Versioning protects in-flight workflows.
controls.requirement: Use Worker Deployment Versions as the default production deployment method, with explicit current/ramping versions and rollback; patch Workflow code only as a documented fallback.
controls.acceptance: An in-progress v1 Workflow remains compatible and correctly routed while v2 starts new Workflows, and rollback preserves both.

controls.control: Workflow and Activity contracts are versioned independently of release SHA.
controls.requirement: Persist workflow_schema and activity contract versions; migrations are additive/backward-compatible or use explicit version routing.
controls.acceptance: Compatibility matrix covers every active retained Workflow version.

controls.control: Event History stays below warning thresholds.
controls.requirement: Measure events and bytes; design Continue-As-New before the official 10,240-event/10-MB warnings and far below the 51,200-event/50-MB hard limits; finish message handlers before Continue-As-New.
controls.acceptance: 30d/90d/1y projections and accelerated tests prove bounded histories.

controls.control: Retention is bounded because canonical evidence lives elsewhere.
controls.requirement: Select 30 or 90 days from measured diagnostic need; do not retain Workflow history as permanent research or thesis storage; document deletion and legal/privacy implications.
controls.acceptance: Namespace retention matches policy and canonical domain records remain queryable after history expiry.

controls.control: Temporal observability complements domain observability.
controls.requirement: Collect Worker and Service/Cloud metrics, Workflow terminal states, task latency, retries, timeout, cancellation, cost-gate results, source SHA, and history growth; preserve existing DecisionPayload and call accounting as canonical domain evidence.
controls.acceptance: Dashboards and alerts distinguish orchestration failure from business rejection and provider failure.

controls.control: Command Center diagnostics expose bounded workflow status.
controls.requirement: Expose execution ID/link, last successful stage, failure type, retry state, source SHA, and as-of time only; do not expose secrets, raw payloads, or Temporal internals on investment cards.
controls.acceptance: Operator can diagnose a failed advisory workflow without SSH and without seeing confidential payload content.

controls.control: Shadow migration has one authoritative writer.
controls.requirement: Start OLD_WRITE/TEMPORAL_SHADOW with comparison receipts, then switch atomically to TEMPORAL_WRITE/OLD_DISABLED; prohibit uncontrolled dual writes and cycles between CIOEventBus and Temporal.
controls.acceptance: Dual-run evidence has one authoritative row per business identity and a documented cutover receipt.

controls.control: Rollback preserves canonical records.
controls.requirement: Disable new Workflow starts, pause/terminate in-flight Workflows under a preregistered policy, restore the old scheduler, and preserve research/theses/decisions without deleting domain data.
controls.acceptance: Isolated rollback drill restores the old path without duplicate or missing canonical records.

controls.control: Self-hosted Temporal is never exposed to the public Internet.
controls.requirement: Bind to localhost or a trusted internal network, firewall the gRPC Frontend and UI, and permit only explicit Worker/operator sources.
controls.acceptance: External port scan is closed and internal allowlist tests pass.

controls.control: Self-hosted internode and Frontend traffic uses mTLS.
controls.requirement: Configure separate internode/frontend trust, require client authentication, validate server names, rotate certificates, and alert before expiry.
controls.acceptance: Untrusted certificates fail and approved clients connect after rotation.

controls.control: The unsafe noop Authorizer is prohibited.
controls.requirement: Configure a ClaimMapper and Authorizer that fail closed, separates read/worker/admin roles, and denies unauthorized namespace and administrative APIs.
controls.acceptance: Startup fails if authorization is absent; negative API tests are denied.

controls.control: UI authentication and authorization are mandatory.
controls.requirement: Enable SSO/OAuth or an equivalent authenticated internal gateway; no anonymous UI; admin APIs remain separately restricted.
controls.acceptance: Unauthenticated UI access fails and role tests pass.

controls.control: Build the audit capability absent from self-host defaults.
controls.requirement: Record authenticated principal, namespace, operation, target, timestamp, decision, and source address for administrative and data-plane APIs; protect and export logs.
controls.acceptance: Audit coverage test captures permitted and denied calls.

controls.control: Temporal persistence is isolated from canonical Trade AI truth.
controls.requirement: Use dedicated Temporal and Temporal Visibility databases or a dedicated PostgreSQL instance with separate roles, credentials, connection limits, backups, and blast-radius analysis; never reuse trade_ai domain tables.
controls.acceptance: Role tests deny cross-database domain access and resource-failure tests quantify shared-server impact.

controls.control: Persistence and Visibility backups are restorable.
controls.requirement: Define encrypted database-native backups, RPO/RTO, retention, off-host copy, restore procedure, schema-version compatibility, and periodic restore testing. Treat Archival as history retention, not database disaster recovery.
controls.acceptance: A clean-environment restore resumes a persisted test Workflow at the documented compatible version.

controls.control: Server and schemas upgrade sequentially under test.
controls.requirement: Pin image digests; upgrade to the highest patch then one minor at a time; update persistence and Visibility schemas with matching tools; load-test staging; keep rollback and backups.
controls.acceptance: Staging upgrade preserves active Workflow availability and restores from pre-upgrade backup.

controls.control: Service, persistence, and Workflow terminal metrics are monitored.
controls.requirement: Collect request/error/latency, persistence request/error/latency, Workflow completion/failure/timeout/cancel, queue backlog, poller, shard/capacity, disk, connection, and certificate metrics with actionable alerts.
controls.acceptance: Fault injection causes the expected alert and runbook action.

blockers: no Temporal POC or production service is authorized by this checklist
Worker static authority guards are not yet implemented/proven
ambiguous provider-call idempotency is not yet failure-injection proven
Cloud identity, payload encryption, audit export, retention, and cost are not configured or accepted
Worker Versioning and exact-release source pin are not yet proven
single-writer migration and rollback are not yet proven
